# sigma_tags (Data Source)

Lists Sigma version tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_tags" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Tag color.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `description` (String) Tag description.
- `id` (String) Version tag ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the tag is archived.
- `name` (String) Tag name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
